**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] User is seeking help with the PayPal API for subscriptions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] PayPal provides a REST API that enables the creation and management of payments, subscriptions, and recurring billing agreements.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To get started with the PayPal API, the user needs to sign up for a PayPal developer account, create an app, and obtain API credentials (client ID and secret).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Steps to create a recurring subscription using the PayPal API include creating a plan, creating an agreement, redirecting the payer, executing the agreement, and managing the agreement.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The endpoint to create a plan is `/v1/billing/plans`.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The endpoint to create an agreement is `/v1/payments/billing-agreements`.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The endpoint to execute the agreement is `/v1/payments/billing-agreements/{agreement_id}/agreement-execute`.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Provided a PHP code example for creating a recurring subscription using the PayPal API.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The PHP code example includes creating a plan with a name, description, type, payment definitions, and merchant preferences.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User requested an example in JavaScript.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Provided a JavaScript code example for creating a recurring subscription using the PayPal API.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The JavaScript code example includes creating a plan and an agreement, and redirecting the payer.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User wants the subscription to renew on the 15th day of every new quarter.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To set the subscription to renew on the 15th day of every new quarter, the frequency should be set to `Month` and the frequency interval to `3`.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The amount for the quarterly subscription should be set to `24.99` USD.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The start date for the agreement should be set to the 15th day of the current quarter.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Provided a complete JavaScript code example for a quarterly subscription with the specified settings.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The PayPal API does not prevent users from changing values like the amount in a subscription.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Setting the `auto_bill_amount` parameter in the `merchant_preferences` object to `YES` will automatically bill the payer the specified amount for each billing cycle.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is a good practice to track changes to the billing agreement using the PayPal IPN (Instant Payment Notification) system.
